items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the location 'At the Brass Rail' in response to the interviewer's story about Marian and Jimmy McPartland. No personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee and Jimmy McPartland is described.

ctx.x: Well not all of it but some of it. That’s right after our daughter died. And also the drummer that worked with us, Jimmy Molinari, he’d been with us a while, he got killed. Somebody killed him down in Manhattan somewhere. And we don’t know the —
It was two weeks after our daughter died, and Jimmy—
It was a double whammy you know.
